design.decision: Break [♠]s early and lead them to draw opponents' trumps, which is the opposite of the ruffing plan and protects side-suit honors.
design.opponent: Shown on the first [♠] lead; opponents hold up high [♠]s to punish leads from length.
design.rationale: This gives Spades a second play pattern (draw trumps) next to ra-trump-x (ruff), so the archetype has a real fork. It fires on a choice of card, has no milestone, and defends side-suit builds.
design.draftText: ×1.25 contract multiplier when your team leads [♠]

critic.concerns: Same signature and amount as cut common e-lead-suit-s-xmult (pre-tournament lift +14.7), a reasonable rarity move; per-event compounding is hard to track.
